Jim Ratcliffe Criticized for Remarks on UK's Decline

Jim Ratcliffe, owner of Manchester United, has faced criticism for comments suggesting the UK is "on the slide" and that he understands why wealthy individuals are leaving the country. The Manchester United Muslim Supporters Club has called for Ratcliffe to leave his position. One report described Ratcliffe as "living on another planet" following his remarks.
